command:
export PATH=/var/jb/usr/bin:/var/jb/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/usr/sbin:/bin:/sbin
D=/var/mobile/macws_r003_evidence_20261018
LOG=/var/tmp/r003-oslog.txt
rm -f "$LOG"
oslog --info > "$LOG" 2>&1 &
L=$!
echo "OSLOG_PID=$L"
sleep 1
echo "=== STOP OLD GENERATION"
bash /var/jb/usr/macOS/bin/macos_gui.sh stop 2>&1 | tail -3
echo "STOP_RC=$?"
sleep 1
echo "=== START FRESH GENERATION (no-vnc)"
rm -f /var/jb/var/mobile/WindowServer.err
bash /var/jb/usr/macOS/bin/macos_gui.sh start coexist --no-vnc 2>&1 | tail -12
START_RC=$?
echo "START_RC=$START_RC"
sleep 1
echo "=== NEW JOBS"
launchctl list 2>/dev/null | grep -E "tccd-system|windowserver"
echo "=== TCCD PRINT"
launchctl print user/501/com.macwsguide.tccd-system 2>&1 | grep -E "state =|pid =|com.apple.macosbooter" | head -5
echo "=== WS PRINT"
launchctl print user/501/UIKitApplication:com.macwsguide.windowserver 2>&1 | grep -E "state =|pid =|active count" | head -5
echo "=== COMPOSITE"
cat /var/mnt/rootfs/private/tmp/macws_final_composite.state 2>/dev/null | head -4
echo "=== POSTMIN 1"
/var/jb/usr/macOS/bin/launchdchrootexec 0 0 /var/mnt/rootfs /usr/local/bin/macos_ws_event_probe postmin 2>&1 | grep -E "postmin|SLSPostEventRecord" | tail -3
sleep 2
echo "=== POSTMIN 2"
/var/jb/usr/macOS/bin/launchdchrootexec 0 0 /var/mnt/rootfs /usr/local/bin/macos_ws_event_probe postmin 2>&1 | grep -E "postmin|SLSPostEventRecord" | tail -3
sleep 1
echo "=== HOSTED PROBE JOB"
P="$D/hosted_probe/com.macwsguide.r003-hosted-probe.plist"
cat > "$P" <<'PLIST'
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
  <key>Label</key><string>com.macwsguide.r003-hosted-probe</string>
  <key>ProgramArguments</key>
  <array>
    <string>/var/jb/usr/macOS/bin/launchdchrootexec</string>
    <string>0</string><string>0</string>
    <string>/var/mnt/rootfs</string>
    <string>/usr/local/bin/macwstccdprobe</string>
    <string>preflight</string>
    <string>kTCCServicePostEvent</string>
  </array>
  <key>EnvironmentVariables</key>
  <dict>
    <key>MACWS_LSXPC_TRACE</key><string>1</string>
    <key>PATH</key><string>/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin</string>
  </dict>
  <key>RunAtLoad</key><true/>
  <key>StandardOutPath</key><string>/var/mobile/macws_r003_evidence_20261018/hosted_probe/probe.out</string>
  <key>StandardErrorPath</key><string>/var/mobile/macws_r003_evidence_20261018/hosted_probe/probe.err</string>
</dict>
</plist>
PLIST
rm -f "$D/hosted_probe/probe.out" "$D/hosted_probe/probe.err"
launchctl load "$P"
echo "HOSTED_LOAD_RC=$?"
i=0
while [ $i -lt 20 ]; do
  i=$((i+1)); sleep 1
  if [ -s "$D/hosted_probe/probe.out" ] && grep -q "TCCPREFLIGHT service=" "$D/hosted_probe/probe.out" 2>/dev/null; then break; fi
done
echo "=== HOSTED DOMAINS"
for dom in system user/501 user/0 gui/501; do launchctl print "$dom/com.macwsguide.r003-hosted-probe" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "DOMAIN=$dom"; done
echo "=== HOSTED OUTPUT"
grep -aE "TCCPREFLIGHT|LSXPC-CONN|LSXPC reply|count =|service" "$D/hosted_probe/probe.out" | head -12
launchctl unload "$P" 2>/dev/null
launchctl remove com.macwsguide.r003-hosted-probe 2>/dev/null
echo "HOSTED_CLEANED=$?"
sleep 1
kill "$L" 2>/dev/null
sleep 1
kill -9 "$L" 2>/dev/null
wait "$L" 2>/dev/null
echo "=== OSLOG LINES"; wc -l "$LOG"
echo "=== TCCD REQUEST LINES"
grep -a "tccd\[" "$LOG" | tr -cd "\11\12\15\40-\176" | grep -E "REQUEST:|REQUEST_MSG|responsibility|attribution|AUTHREQ|RECV" | tail -40
